loginLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If you do not have your phone, enter a backup code (12345-67890).
loginNeed: Enter a 6-digit code or a backup code (12345-67890).
loginExpired: Your sign-in session has expired. Please sign in again.
loginLost: If you have no backup code either, contact the help center (Account) and we will reset two-step verification after confirming your identity.
alertNone: No sign-ins from new devices in the last 30 days.
alertText: Sign-ins from a device or place not used in the last 90 days are listed here. If it was not you, press Not me and change your password.
alertNotMeConfirm: That device will be signed out. Continue?
mfaWhy: With this on, no one can sign in without the code from your authenticator app, even if your password leaks. Social sign-in (Kakao, Naver) is blocked and only email sign-in works.
mfaOn: On — you enter an authenticator code when you sign in.
mfaStaffNote: Two-step verification for staff accounts is managed in the admin console.
mfaNeedPw: Accounts that only use social sign-in need to create a password first.
mfaSecret: Enter the secret below in your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, etc.) or tap Open authenticator app on your phone.
mfaBackup: 10 backup codes — shown only now. Write them down (each works once).
mfaLocked: Too many wrong codes. Please try again in 15 minutes.
